tool: Meshy CLI 0.4.0 (meshy-cli on npm), text to 3D, model_type smart-topology, ai_model meshy-t2.5; refine with enable_pbr false, texture_resolution 2k
files: Each GLB here has its 2048 px colour map shrunk to 1024 px by tools/shrink-glb-textures.py; geometry untouched. The 2048 px originals stay in the Meshy account under the refine task id.

models.why: Reads as a bentwood cafe chair from the street and from inside; the code chair (tubes and tori) reads as a ladder or a letter d.
models.prompt: A classic bentwood cafe chair in dark stained beech: a round seat with a woven cane panel, a curved loop backrest, four slightly splayed legs joined by a round wooden ring under the seat. A single chair on its own. Stylised cartoon game prop, chunky clean shapes, flat colours, no text.
models.texturePrompt: Dark walnut-brown stained wood frame, a light golden woven cane seat. Flat cartoon colours, clean, no text.

models.why: Reads as a record player: the open lid, the record and its label, the knobs. The code box reads as a flat box.
models.prompt: A 1970s Japanese portable record player in a warm teak wooden case, the lid open and propped up behind, a black vinyl record with a plain red centre label on the platter, a silver tone arm at rest, two round knobs on the front. A single object on its own. Stylised cartoon game prop, chunky clean shapes, flat colours, no text, no logos.
models.texturePrompt: Warm honey-coloured teak wood case, cream inside of the lid, a black vinyl record with a plain red centre label, silver tone arm, black knobs. Flat cartoon colours, clean, no text, no logos.

models.why: The drawer, its knob, the bowl and the crank read at the counter; the code grinder is a dark cube with a disc.
models.prompt: A traditional wooden hand coffee grinder: a square dark wooden box with a small pull-out drawer at the front, a brass bowl on top, and an iron crank handle with a round wooden knob. A single object on its own. Stylised cartoon game prop, chunky clean shapes, flat colours, no text.
models.texturePrompt: Dark brown wooden box and drawer, a brass bowl on top, a black iron crank, a light wooden knob. Flat cartoon colours, clean, no text.

A single object on its own. Stylised cartoon game prop, chunky clean shapes, flat colours, no text.
models.texturePrompt: Brushed stainless steel body, spout and lid, a black knob on the lid, a black wooden handle. Flat cartoon colours, clean, no text.
